title: Milan: GATED - treadmill incline if walking is clean, otherwise bike
terrain: treadmill 10-12% incline (climbing only) or indoor bike, zero descent either way

steps.target: Z2 at 10-12% incline or bike Z2, 80-88% LTHR

coachNotes: OPTIMAL LOAD RULE, THE GOVERNING GATE FROM 24 AUG: a session passes only if it produces no symptoms during it, none immediately after, and none the next day. Any one of the three is a fail, and the next session drops back to the last level that passed. The ceiling during a run is 2/10 with no spike afterwards; mild is allowed, new or worsening is not. This replaces every softer wording elsewhere in this plan. GAIT, MEASURED FROM THE 22 AUG CADENCE STREAM ON 24 AUG. Your descent cadence is already good and is NOT the problem: 177 spm on grades steeper than -20%, 179 spm across the second half of the sustained descents, 176 on the final descent to the door. Do not change it, and do not let anyone tell you to. THE EXPOSURE IS FLAT AND SHALLOW DOWNHILL: 152 spm on flat ground and 156 spm at -3 to -10%. That is precisely the gradient band where the knee spends longest inside the 20-30 degree compression zone under load, it is the running you do most of, and the final 1250m into Bansko is full of it. TARGET 165-170 spm ON FLAT AND SHALLOW DOWNHILL, a 5-10% lift, which is the range the gait-retraining literature uses. Metronome or a 165 bpm playlist. Shorter steps at the same effort; do not convert it into more pace. STEP WIDTH: run slightly wider than feels natural, not on a tightrope. Narrow step width raises ITB strain and strain rate directly and it is one of the few things you can change inside 19 days. THE GATE: run this on the treadmill ONLY if you have walked for a full 24 hours with no pin sensations at all. Anything at all, even once, and today is the bike again at the same load. Do not average the day out in your head, one pin is a fail. WHY UPHILL IS THE EXCEPTION. If running comes back this week it comes back on a steep treadmill and nowhere else. ITBS is provoked by the knee cycling repeatedly through roughly 20-30 degrees of flexion under load, which is what flat running and especially downhill running do. Steep uphill running keeps the knee outside that band for most of the stride and has no eccentric braking phase at all, so it is the one running modality that buys fitness without paying the band. Hold 10-12%, let the pace be whatever it needs to be, walk the belt if that is what the gradient demands. ABORT RULE: any pin, twinge or lateral knee sensation during the run, step off immediately and finish on the bike. This is not a test of tolerance, we already know the band is talking. It is a test of whether uphill is available to us. NO GYM TODAY, legs recover between the hip blocks. GUT TRAINING CONTINUES REGARDLESS OF MODALITY: 80 g/h means 2 Enervit Carbo Gel C2:1 Pro per hour (40g each, 2:1 glucose-fructose) with 150-250ml of water per gel. Today is 55 minutes so take one gel at minute 30. The bike is a perfectly good place to train a gut, so this part of the week is untouched by the ITB.
